desc: A favorite for generations, Betty Crocker makes it easy to bring this classic combination of real cheese and sliced potatoes to your family table. These perfectly seasoned potatoes cooked in a rich, creamy cheese sauce create an ideal side dish for family meals. They're easy to prepare by adding boiling water, milk, and butter and following the simple steps on the package. With eight servings in this 8-ounce twin pack, keep Betty Crocker Au Gratin Casserole Potatoes on hand as a convenient part of a weeknight dinner or your Sunday brunch spread. Or stock up and serve Betty Crocker potatoes at your next party or event. Hungry for more ways to do meal prep using our potatoes? Look to Betty Crocker recipes for tasty inspiration. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been bringing families easy, delicious recipes. The Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes. Contains one cardboard carton of Betty Crocker Au Gratin Casserole Potatoes, Made with Real Cheese, Twin Pack, 8 oz Box.
features:
AU GRATIN POTATOES: Enjoy Betty Crocker's thinly sliced potatoes in a rich, creamy cheese sauce; A family favorite food and pantry staple for generations

QUICK AND EASY: Have a delicious side dish ready to cook in minutes by simply adding boiling water, milk, and butter; This twin pack contains two pouches - enough for an addition to two meals

TASTY INGREDIENTS: It's made with real cheese and real sliced potatoes for a taste your whole family will enjoy

CHEESY TASTE: This box of Betty Crocker potatoes makes it easy to bring cheesy taste to your family table
